race.description: Tab Saver Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: LADY COWAN (7) is the horse to beat despite having only one race start behind her. She was near the top of an open market on debut at Wagga, jumped awkwardly and was beaten just over nine lengths, so there is a clear case that she can return sharper with that experience behind her. Her time profile for 1200m also reads strongly for this line-up and the nose roll goes on. AQUILINO (1) brings the most exposed race fitness and his second at this track two starts back reads well, beaten just over half a length. Back to his pet trip and the tongue-tie goes on. Top three contender. HEAD CAPITALIST (6) was beaten a head first-up at Wagga Riverside as a short odds-on favourite for the new yard. Tongue-tie comes off and looking for the extra ground now. Leading contender.  TERMEILIAN (9) resumes from a debut in Open company at Wagga on heavy ground, where she was tightened on jumping last June. Well drawn and must be kept safe from the rails draw.
